text.short: The card game. Four players, two pairs, bidding in four rounds, and signals across the table that everyone can see and nobody is supposed to.
text.note: Friday nights in Elko you can watch it or sit in. NABO runs a mus tournament across its clubs.

etymology.gloss: the call that opens a new hand

kin.how: runs a tournament of it between clubs
another thing a shared table is for
